messages:
rachel: FYI I opened a PR to reconcile the API ref for POST /v1/ingest. The curl example, JSON schema, and Node snippet are inconsistent: some examples use `uid`, others `user_id`, and `metadata` is marked required but server accepts null/omitted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4390

juan: Repro'd locally against staging. Server accepts both `uid` and `user_id` today, but docs should show the canonical `user_id`. Also the schema currently says `metadata: object` (required) which is incorrect.

anya: We need a migration/compat note so customers using old SDKs know the mapping. Can we add a tiny table in docs/migration/legacy-fields.md?

rachel: Yes. My PR does these things: (1) make examples use `user_id` consistently, (2) change schema description to "nullable object" for `metadata`, (3) add two JSON example variants (with metadata object and `metadata: null`), (4) add a one-line mapping snippet for legacy clients, (5) update curl/node/python snippets.

juan: Example suggestions:
```json
{
  "user_id": "alice",
  "content": "order status?",
  "metadata": {"platform":"ios"}
}
```
and
```json
{
  "user_id": "alice",
  "content": "order status?",
  "metadata": null
}
```
Also add "or omit `metadata`" note.

anya: For the migration doc suggest wording: "Legacy field mappings: `uid` -> `user_id`. Servers accept both during the deprecation window (see timeline). Update SDKs to send `user_id` before YYYY-MM-DD."

rachel: Added that text and a short timeline bullet. I also changed the Python snippet to `metadata=None` instead of `{}` to avoid implying an empty object. Node example uses `metadata: null`. I included a tiny smoke test in docs CI that parses the code blocks as JSON to catch drift: docs/test_examples/test_ingest_examples.py. Link in PR description.

juan: Nice. Can you also add a TODO to verify generated SDKs (the generator picks up schema descriptions) so we don't accidentally regenerate wrong shapes?

rachel: Added a follow-up issue in the PR and left a TODO in the migration doc.

docs-bot: PR opened by rachel: #4390 "ingest API examples: canonical field names + nullable metadata". CI queued.

anya: LGTM apart from one nit on tone in migration doc. Recommend "Deprecation timeline" header and a clearer date.

rachel: Will update wording and ping @juan for quick review. Thanks all :rocket:
